synthetic_forest_localization.description: Scaled tree-inventory reproduction of TreeLoc's core forest place-recognition and localization claim; reference values are TreeLoc and BTC results from the paper's Oxford Stein 3-DoF localization setting where metrics overlap.

R_at_1.description: Fraction of queries whose top retrieved database scene is within the positive-distance neighborhood.

F1.description: Best thresholded pair-classification F1 over all query/database similarity scores.

AUC.description: Average precision for ranking positive query/database pairs above negative pairs.

R_at_50.description: Fraction of queries whose top retrieved match also yields a relative pose within the localization thresholds.

SR.description: Pose-estimation success rate conditioned on retrieving a positive top match.

TE_m.description: Mean translation error in meters over successfully localized top matches.

RE_deg.description: Mean rotation error in degrees over successfully localized top matches.

TE_all_m.description: Mean translation error in meters over all top predictions, assigning a fixed miss penalty when the top retrieved scene is outside the positive-distance neighborhood.

RE_all_deg.description: Mean rotation error in degrees over all top predictions, assigning a fixed miss penalty when the top retrieved scene is outside the positive-distance neighborhood.
